title: Relation Extraction
motto: NER found the entities. Entity linking anchored them. Relation extraction finds the edges between them. A knowledge graph is the sum of nodes, edges, and their provenance.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: NER found the entities. Entity linking anchored them. Relation extraction finds the edges between them. A knowledge graph is the sum of nodes, edges, and their provenance.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: An analyst reads: "Tim Cook became CEO of Apple in 2011." Four facts:

- `(Tim Cook, role, CEO)`
- `(Tim Cook, employer, Apple)`
- `(Tim Cook, start_date, 2011)`
- `(Apple, type, Organization)`

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: Triples (subject, relation, object) build knowledge graphs.
